setup: Controlled torso-hinge variation: start light and move smoothly.
Sit on the fixed bench; brace both feet with knees slightly bent.

advice.tip: Use a small, comfortable torso hinge. Avoid bouncing or leaning far back to move the load.
commonMistakes: Jerking the handle or using excessive momentum.
Straightening the knees to drive the movement.
Pulling high toward the shoulders instead of the lower ribs.

approval.instruction: get spin bike merged then carry on with the other 10, same model and colours, no shorts. stop repeating failed attempts and asking for approval, just get them finished
